authority: This ledger is the durable record of what P2P researched, selected, rejected, and shipped, reconciled from repository evidence. It is append-and-reconcile only: historical records are never rewritten. External research is provenance, not authority. P2P adopts ideas selectively, not repositories wholesale.

Chat memory is never a source of truth.
